name: Sealbreaker Vault
introDiscord:
A locked royal reliquary has already been broken into.

Repeatedly.

Sealbreaker Lobsters appear to treat ancient royal seals as puzzle toys.
introTwitch:
A locked royal reliquary has already been broken into.

Sealbreaker Lobsters appear to treat ancient royal seals as puzzle toys.

sealbreaker-vault-approach.prompt: Sealbreaker Vault opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's note:

'Door had seven locks.

Lobster opened six.

I opened zero.

Promoted Lobster to locksmith.'

right.message: An already-open reliquary contains Star Candies.

forward.message: A Sealbreaker Lobster guards the mechanism it has been dismantling.

sealbreaker-vault-depths.prompt: Deeper within Sealbreaker Vault, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A Lobster snaps another royal seal.

right.message:
Shizuki's medicine:

'Locksmith-related injury.

Locksmith has claws.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A hidden royal coffer has been exposed behind a broken lock.

sealbreaker-vault-threshold.prompt: Near Forbidden Reliquary, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A ceremonial chalice contains Star Candies.

right.message: A Sealbreaker Lobster tackles the final seal.

forward.message:

'Door status:

open.

moral support.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

Something enormous pushes through from inside the reliquary.

union alone.

completionText:
The Forbidden Reliquary opens.

The Lobsters immediately begin dismantling something else.

Professionals.
